brief:
Mahmoud Abbas told the United Nations that Israeli policies endanger the survival of the Palestinian people, Al Jazeera English reported. The Palestinian Authority president said protecting the two-state solution requires preserving Palestinian land and safeguarding those living on it.

Abbas linked the viability of a future Palestinian state to immediate steps to halt territorial loss and defend the population from current threats.
dek: Mahmoud Abbas says saving two-state solution begins with preserving Palestinian land, protecting those who live on it.
title: Abbas tells UN Israel's policies threaten Palestinian existence
